name: Idol of the Beast of Blight

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from Hartsblight Forest; the book's numbers, our words.

powers.name: Touch of Oblivion
powers.text: Over a fresh corpse within 5 ft: your next Unarmed Strike that hits is a Critical Hit.

powers.name: Rot in the Flesh
powers.text: Barkskin on yourself; while it lasts, a creature that hits you in melee takes 1d8 Necrotic.

summary: A Fabled Heirloom idol carved from a dead stag's bone: +1 to spell attacks and save DCs (+2 at level 7, +3 at 13). Rotting Touch: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 Necrotic more (1d8 from level 7, 1d10 from 13); Touch of Oblivion turns the next one into a Critical Hit. From level 7, Hallucinatory Spores after each spell cast with a slot (a foe within 10 ft: Wisdom save or 2d6 Psychic and Disadvantage on its attacks) and Rot in the Flesh once a dusk.
